We need to actually call search_template_catalog_by_criteria to get template IDs. Let's do three searches.

First amide formation: functional_groups_broken=["carboxylic_acid"], functional_groups_formed=["amide"], maybe bonds_broken=["C-O"], bonds_formed=["C-N"].

Second Doebner: functional_groups_broken=["aldehyde","carboxylic_acid"], functional_groups_formed=["alkene","carboxylic_acid"], bonds_broken=["C=O"], bonds_formed=["C=C"].

Third sulfonamide formation: functional_groups_broken=["sulfonyl_chloride"], functional_groups_formed=["sulfonamide"], bonds_broken=["S-Cl"], bonds_formed=["S-N"].

Let's call search_template_catalog_by_criteria for each.
